columns.title: How to read the assumptions
columns.text: All are team assumptions. R&S is rental and services revenue. Two unsourced assumptions (rows C1 and C4) carry the case: M1 supplies 47% of the FY2028E uplift and M1 plus M4 supply 79%. Chapter 6 adopts the +10% and +5% as [Proposed] targets; they are set equal to the assumptions and are not evidence for them.

columns.title: Reading the margin result
columns.text: Our 35.5% floor is the team's calculation, 18,841 / 53,009 = 35.54%, rounded. It holds ฿2,119 million of after-tax one-off Rama 2 gains (3.2 points); on KPI K8's core test the base path is 33.9% against a [Proposed] core floor of 32.3%. Without the plan the base margin would be 35.2% in FY2027E, so the organic path already sits below the floor. Base-case FY2027E profit is ฿558 million short of it (rounded floor).

notes: Backup slide, not presented. Table 5.2 lists the main team assumptions; the scenario table combines Tables 5.8 and 5.11. The base case misses both F1 tests in FY2027E and only the optimistic case, which is defined as target-met, passes. The international row applies the 13.7% visit share to revenue, which assumes a foreign visit earns the same as a Thai visit (team assumption, not tested).
